pre_condition: target_desc is a string; source_desc is a string
post_condition: Returns a string formed by appending the stripped text of source_desc to target_desc. When the stripped text of source_desc is empty, returns target_desc unchanged. When target_desc already contains the full stripped text of source_desc, returns target_desc unchanged. When target_desc is empty and stripped source_desc is non-empty, returns stripped source_desc. Otherwise, returns the concatenation of target_desc and stripped source_desc with a separator between them.
